notes.title: [PATCH NOTES] Pre-Release Build v0.0.7.43 - Project Carrot
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added Project Carrot.
[/list]

[i]Note: Project Carrot is still very rough, and lacking content. The main systems are implemented now, but it's lacking content and balancing. I'll be working on this soon![/i]

notes.title: [PATCH NOTES] Pre-Release Build v0.0.6.42 - Advanced Minesweeping!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added different difficulties to Minesweeper!
[*] Easy, Medium, Hard, and an Extreme difficulty unlocked after beating Hard mode once.
[*] Added stats for Minesweeper difficulties.
[*] Added that advanced Minesweeper functionality to allow you to click a revealed cell and, if all relevant nearby flags are placed, the game will reveal cells in a 1-cell radius.
[*] Increased performance and graphical fidelity in Minesweeper!
[/list]
